items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The mpkcn design tokens: dark and light palettes, mono and sans fonts, and the blink animation as Tailwind 4 theme variables.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: Theme Provider
items.description: next-themes with the mpkcn defaults (class attribute, dark first, dark and light only). The CLI wires it into your root layout.

items.name: boot-screen
items.title: Boot Screen
items.description: A tuigreet-style login screen with a typed username, password dots and optional matrix rain that plays before your page appears.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: A dark and light switch for next-themes, as a round icon button or a mono text flag, with no hydration flash.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Fades and slides content in as it scrolls into view, and keeps still under reduced motion.

items.name: ascii-image
items.title: ASCII Image
items.description: An image that starts as a wall of flickering code glyphs and decodes into the real picture in a left-to-right sweep.

items.name: back-to-top
items.title: Back to Top
items.description: A small square button that appears after the first screen and scrolls back up, with a reduced-motion jump and optional focus target.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A terminal-style Ctrl+K command palette with groups, fuzzy word filtering and full keyboard control, as a dialog or inline.

items.name: cursor
items.title: Cursor
items.description: A terminal-style pointer follower, a block caret with a trailing square ring and magnetic buttons, that steps aside for touch, text fields, the keyboard and reduced motion.

items.name: eyebrow
items.title: Eyebrow
items.description: A small mono label for above a heading that types itself out, with a block cursor, as it scrolls into view.

items.name: feature-list
items.title: Feature List
items.description: A spec-sheet list of label and value rows between hairlines, sliding in one by one.

items.name: grain
items.title: Grain
items.description: A static film-grain overlay in two blend layers that stays visible on both the dark and the light theme, at no per-frame cost.

items.name: image-placeholder
items.title: Image Placeholder
items.description: A framed image slot that shows a striped placeholder with a mono label until the image exists or when it fails to load.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key badge with a thick bottom edge, for single keys or combos like Ctrl + K.

items.name: konami
items.title: Konami
items.description: A useKonami hook and an easter-egg component that fires a callback and plays matrix rain when someone types the Konami code.

items.name: letter-reveal
items.title: Letter Reveal
items.description: Splits a heading into letters that spring up and flip into place one after another.

items.name: scene-canvas
items.title: Scene Canvas
items.description: A slow wave rippling through a grid of dots on a canvas, capped at 30fps and paused off screen, in hidden tabs, on weak devices and under reduced motion.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: A thin accent bar that fills as the page or a scroll container is scrolled.

items.name: section-divider
items.title: Section Divider
items.description: A terminal-style break between sections: hairlines grow out and a linked label types "EOF about $ cd ../work".

items.name: section-rail
items.title: Section Rail
items.description: A slim side rail of numbered dots that tracks the section in view and jumps to a section on click.

items.name: roadmap
items.title: Roadmap
items.description: A roadmap of milestones joined by a path that draws itself as you scroll, with a marker travelling along it and stops that light up when reached.

items.name: shortcuts-dialog
items.title: Shortcuts Dialog
items.description: A keyboard-shortcut cheat sheet in a terminal-style dialog that opens with "?".

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: A panel with a soft accent glow that follows the pointer while it hovers, drawn in CSS without re-rendering.

items.name: terminal-form
items.title: Terminal Form
items.description: A form that runs like a terminal prompt: one question at a time, editable answers, then a confirm step that hands the values to your callback.

items.name: terminal-shell
items.title: Terminal Shell
items.description: An interactive fake shell: you pass the commands, it handles the prompt, history, tab completion, help, clear and Ctrl+L.

items.name: terminal-window
items.title: Terminal Window
items.description: A terminal window with title bar and dots that types out commands and their output line by line, then shows your content.

items.name: tmux-bar
items.title: Tmux Bar
items.description: A tmux-style status bar with a session block, clickable windows, custom segments, a clock, uptime and scroll position.

items.name: arch-diagram
items.title: Arch Diagram
items.description: A small architecture diagram of boxes on a grid joined by right-angled lines; pick a box to light up its links and print its details.

items.name: case-card
items.title: Case Card
items.description: A project case study card: name, one-liner, tags, links and a screenshot beside a spec-sheet list of features.

items.name: env-card
items.title: Env Card
items.description: Contact or config details shown as a syntax-colored .env file, with links, copy buttons and masked secrets.

items.name: fetch-card
items.title: Fetch Card
items.description: A neofetch-style info card: ASCII art, a user@host header, key / value rows and a palette strip, with lines that slide in and art that tilts towards the pointer.

items.name: file-explorer
items.title: File Explorer
items.description: A ranger-style file browser with Miller columns, a preview pane, a path bar and a / filter, driven entirely from the keyboard.

items.name: media-lightbox
items.title: Media Lightbox
items.description: An accessible image and video lightbox with arrows, keyboard and swipe navigation, thumbnails, click-to-zoom and a focus trap.

items.name: parallax-image
items.title: Parallax Image
items.description: An image in a viewfinder frame that drifts with the pointer and with scroll, and holds still under reduced motion.

items.name: prompt-footer
items.title: Prompt Footer
items.description: A site footer laid out as a shell session: ls prints your link columns, date the copyright and an optional live clock, and the last prompt blinks.

items.name: scroll-hint
items.title: Scroll Hint
items.description: An animated scroll-down indicator (line, chevron or mouse) that fades out as you scroll and can jump to the next section.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.description: A sticky terminal-style top bar with a logo slot and block cursor, numbered links with a sliding active marker, an actions slot and a drop-down mobile menu.

items.name: tech-stack
items.title: Tech Stack
items.description: A tech stack grouped by category, as a stack.json file or a chip grid, with optional icons and a jq-style detail panel for the picked item.

items.name: font-space-grotesk
items.title: Space Grotesk
items.description: Space Grotesk for the mpkcn theme, as the --font-space-grotesk variable.

items.name: font-jetbrains-mono
items.title: JetBrains Mono
items.description: JetBrains Mono for the mpkcn theme, as the --font-jetbrains-mono variable.
